description: Buyer-configurable surface for the Elevarq Signals Amazon EKS add-on. AWS reads THIS file (not values.schema.json) to render the add-on's configuration in the EKS console and to validate the configurationValues passed to create-addon/update-addon (aws eks describe-addon-configuration returns it). Keys mirror the Helm chart's value paths so a configurationValues blob overrides the chart directly. No field accepts a secret value (passwords, keys, certificates) — identity is supplied by reference (Kubernetes Secret names, filesystem paths, or the add-on's IRSA role ARN set via the Amazon EKS add-on API), per AWS Marketplace INVALID_HELM_SENSITIVE_CONFIG. Cluster metadata (region, cluster name) is auto-injected by Amazon EKS and is deliberately absent.

target.description: PostgreSQL target to collect from. Set host to enable collection. Token/secret/mtls auth methods require sslmode verify-full.

host.description: PostgreSQL hostname, e.g. the RDS endpoint. Required to enable collection.

user.description: PostgreSQL role the collector authenticates as (read-only monitoring role).

sslmode.description: TLS mode for the PostgreSQL connection. verify-full is required for token/secret/mtls auth.

authMethod.description: Connection auth method. Empty = password. aws_rds_iam / azure_entra / gcp_cloudsql_iam are passwordless (cloud identity).

region.description: AWS region of the RDS target for aws_rds_iam. This is the database region, not the EKS cluster region; when omitted it is resolved from the pod's ambient region.

azureClientId.description: User-assigned managed-identity client id for azure_entra; when omitted the chain default is used.

gcpImpersonateServiceAccount.description: Service account to impersonate for gcp_cloudsql_iam; when omitted the ambient ADC identity is used.

secretRef.description: secret_store only: cloud vault REFERENCE (AWS Secrets Manager / SSM Parameter Store ARN, Azure Key Vault secret URI, or GCP Secret Manager resource name). A reference, never the secret value.

sslRootCertFile.description: Filesystem PATH to the CA bundle for verify-full (never the certificate contents). Mount it via a Secret/ConfigMap and point this at the mount path.

passwordSecretName.description: Password method: NAME of a pre-created Kubernetes Secret holding the password. The add-on reads the value at runtime; the secret value is never supplied here.

passwordSecretKey.description: Password method: key within passwordSecretName whose value is the password.

pollInterval.description: Collection cycle interval as a duration (e.g. 5m, 1h, 1d).

retentionDays.description: Days of collected data to retain locally; 0 or negative disables cleanup.

persistence.description: Durable storage for the collector's local SQLite snapshot store. A PersistentVolume is required so collection history and instance identity survive pod replacement.

enabled.description: Whether to provision a PersistentVolumeClaim for /data. Must be true for production.

size.description: PVC size, e.g. 10Gi, sized for retention × snapshot rate.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the PVC. On EKS set an EBS-CSI class (e.g. an encrypted gp3 with a retain policy).

api.description: Control-plane API. The bearer token is supplied by reference to a Kubernetes Secret, never inline.

tokenSecretName.description: NAME of a Kubernetes Secret holding the API bearer token; recommended for production so the token survives restarts.

tokenSecretKey.description: Key within tokenSecretName whose value is the bearer token.

env.description: Runtime environment. prod hard-fails on weak API tokens and requires verify-full for token auth.

resources.description: Kubernetes resource requests/limits for the collector container.
